exposure: previous surgeries (laparotomy for bowel surgery, cesarean section/gynecologic surgeries)
outcome: postoperative complication (surgical site infection, seroma formation, recurrence)
cohort: The study included all adult patients who underwent open mesh hernia repair at St. Paul's Hospital Millennium Medical College from September 2013 to August 2016.
finding: Meshes are being increasingly used for incisional and recurrent inguinal hernias, with observed outcomes, including a 10.8% postoperative complication rate, comparable to those reported in literature.
mod_finding: Cesarean section/gynecologic surgeries were a common prior surgery (29.7%) contributing to the development of incisional hernias.
